title: Central Pacific Bank and Patsy T. Mink Center Announce 2026 Class of We by CPB Rising Tide Program
summary: Central Pacific Bank (CPB) and the Patsy T. Mink Center for Business and Leadership are proud to introduce the 2026 cohort for the WE by CPB Rising Tide program. Marking its sixth year of driving local economic growth, the program has selected 20 outstanding women entrepreneurs from across Hawaii—including seven businesses from Hawaii Island—equipping them with the strategic tools, resources, and networking opportunities to grow their operations.
body_markdown:
*WE by CPB Rising Tide cohort six program participants met for their first of 10 sessions on Aug. 26, 2026. Photo courtesy: Central Pacific Bank*


HONOLULU, HI (Sept. 2, 2026) –


[Central Pacific Bank (CPB)](https://www.cpb.bank/) and the[Patsy T. Mink Center for Business and Leadership](https://www.mcblhawaii.org/) are proud to introduce the 2026 cohort for the


[WE by CPB Rising Tide](https://www.cpb.bank/cpb-rising-tide/women-entrepreneurs/) program. Marking its sixth year of driving local economic growth, the program has selected 20 outstanding women entrepreneurs from across Hawaii—including seven businesses from Hawaii Island—equipping them with the strategic tools, resources, and networking opportunities to grow their operations.

“Investing in women entrepreneurs creates a powerful ripple effect that strengthens Hawaii's entire business ecosystem,” said **Sharene Urakami-Oyama** , VP and Small Business Market Manager at Central Pacific Bank. “This cohort showcases incredible vision and determination, and CPB is committed to giving these leaders the capital insights and strategic backing they need to build sustainable, long-term success.”


“Each year, we witness firsthand the bold vision, innovation, and resilience driving our local business community forward,” said **Brittany Montilliano** , Director of the Patsy T. Mink Center for Business & Leadership. “We are proud to welcome these 20 exceptional leaders into a transformative environment grounded in collaboration, executive mentorship, and actionable growth strategies to accelerate their businesses.”


**Program Highlights**


The comprehensive 10-week curriculum is tailored to the unique operational demands of growing enterprises, featuring:


- Advanced Financial Management: Deepen skills in managing complex cash flow dynamics, capital acquisition strategies, and long-range financial planning.


- Executive Networking: Connect directly with established corporate leaders, industry experts, and a powerful network of peer business owners.


- Neighbor Island Support: Travel assistance is provided to participants joining from neighbor islands, ensuring statewide access to all program sessions.


For additional information on the WE by CPB Rising Tide program and to view the full 2026 program schedule, please


[click here](https://www.cpb.bank/cpb-rising-tide/women-entrepreneurs/) .
